before: The Insert link controls asked only whether the engine accepts a link, and opened a popover state even when no link panel was mounted.
after: The Insert link controls are enabled only while a link panel is registered, and they open it through the same request as Ctrl+K or Cmd+K.
reason: Only local chrome registration and control state change. The link panel commits the same link operations as before, so shared nodes, operations, and serialization are unchanged. The two-peer link popover tests still converge.
